units.source_text: 是年冬天，因在尼姑藤壶母后丧服之后，宫中神事一概停止。

en.t: That winter, because the court was still in mourning after the death of the nun Fujitsubo, all Shinto rites in the palace were suspended.

units.source_text: 源氏公子寂寞无聊之极，照例出门去访问五公主。

en.t: Prince Genji, feeling unbearably lonely and bored, went out as usual to visit the Fifth Princess.

units.source_text: 此时瑞雪纷飞，暮景异常艳丽。

en.t: At that moment auspicious snow was falling thickly, and the evening scene was unusually beautiful.

units.source_text: 日常穿惯的衣裳上，今天衣香熏得特别浓重，

en.t: On the garments he usually wore, the fragrance of incense had been steeped especially deeply today,

units.source_text: 周身打扮也特别讲究。

en.t: and his whole appearance was arranged with exceptional care.

units.source_text: 心情脆弱的女子看见了，安得不爱慕呢？

en.t: How could any tenderhearted woman see him and fail to fall in love?

units.source_text: 他毕竟还得向紫夫人告辞，对她言道：“五姑母身上不好，我想去探望一下。”

en.t: Still, he had to take leave of Lady Murasaki, and said to her, "My fifth aunt is unwell, so I would like to go and visit her."

units.source_text: 他略坐一会，但紫姬对他看也不看一眼。

en.t: He sat for a short while, but Lady Murasaki would not even glance at him.

units.source_text: 她管自和小女公子玩耍，那侧影的神色异乎寻常。

en.t: She simply went on playing with the little princess, and the look of her profile was strangely unlike her usual self.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对她说：“近来你的神色很古怪。

en.t: Prince Genji said to her, "Lately your manner has been very strange.

units.source_text: 我又不曾得罪你。

en.t: I have done nothing to offend you.

units.source_text: 只是想起‘彼此不宜太亲昵’这句古话，所以常常离家往宫中住宿。

en.t: It is only that I remembered the old saying, 'People should not be too intimate with one another,' and so I often leave home to stay at the palace.

units.source_text: 你又多心了。”

en.t: You are being oversensitive again."

units.source_text: 紫姬只回答一声“太亲昵了的确多痛苦”，便背转身去躺下了。

en.t: Lady Murasaki only answered, "Being too intimate truly brings much pain," then turned her back and lay down.

units.source_text: 源氏公子不忍离开她而出门去。

en.t: Prince Genji could hardly bear to leave her and go out.

units.source_text: 但是已经有信通知五公主，只得出去了。

en.t: But since he had already sent word to the Fifth Princess, he had no choice but to leave.

units.source_text: 紫姬躺着寻思：“我一向信任他，想不到夫妻之间会发生这种事情。”

en.t: As Lady Murasaki lay there, she thought, "I have always trusted him, and never imagined such a thing could happen between husband and wife."

units.source_text: 源氏公子穿的虽然是灰色的丧服，但是色彩调和，式样称体，非常美观。

en.t: Although Prince Genji was wearing gray mourning clothes, the colors were harmonious, the cut suited him, and he looked extraordinarily handsome.

units.source_text: 映着雪光，更是艳丽。

en.t: Set against the light of the snow, he appeared even more splendid.

units.source_text: 紫姬目送他的后影，心念今后这个人倘使真个舍我而去，

en.t: Lady Murasaki watched his figure from behind and thought that if this man were truly to abandon her someday,

units.source_text: 何等可悲呵！

en.t: how terribly sad it would be.

units.source_text: 便觉忧伤不堪。

en.t: At that thought, she was overcome with unbearable sorrow.
